Deep understanding of timeseries forecasting, machine learning algorithms, data processing, and model optimization techniques

Demonstrated experience crafting, performing, and analyzing experiments
Proficiency working in a cloud computing environment

Keen attention to detail. You do not need someone to inspect your work
